statement.notes: For revenue, used 'Sales and other operating revenue' line (excluding equity income and other income) as it represents core operating revenue. For operating_expenses, calculated as sum of: crude oil and product purchases, production and manufacturing expenses, selling, general and administrative expenses, depreciation and depletion, exploration expenses, non-service pension and postretirement benefit expense, and other taxes and duties (excluding interest expense which is mapped separately). Net income uses 'Net income (loss) attributable to ExxonMobil'. Taxes uses 'Income tax expense (benefit)'. Interest expenses uses 'Interest expense' line.
